verdict.rationale: Stripe documents real public API surfaces for agentic commerce. These include the v2 Product Catalog Import API with webhooks and 403 permission semantics, an SPT create call with usage_limits and revocation, the List CheckoutSessions endpoint for bulk fulfillment, and HTTP 402 machine-payment flows. Agents get programmatic access through a live hosted MCP server, restricted API keys and keyless sandbox provisioning. missing for 10: much of ACS (the agent-side embedded checkout and the custom checkout endpoint) is private preview or waitlist-gated; no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths; community feedback says the MPP docs are sparse on end-to-end object semantics.
